name: Sourcegraph Code Finder
desc: Search tool that hands a coding agent the exact files it needs.
desc_zh: 把编程智能体真正需要的文件直接递给它的智能体搜索工具。
solves: An agent searching a codebase itself burns context and still returns the wrong files; Code Finder runs its own loop and returns precise ranges.
solves_zh: 智能体自己搜代码库既烧上下文又常找错文件；Code Finder 自己跑检索循环，返回精确范围。
best_for: Your agent keeps opening the wrong files before it can make the change you asked for.
best_for_zh: 你的智能体在做你要的改动前总打开错文件。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — sourcegraph.com/blog）。 Post dated July 23, 2026 by Stephanie Jarmak and Jan Hartman. The post states Code Finder is an agentic search tool inside the Sourcegraph MCP server, so surface is in-product rather than standalone. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：官方名字只是「Code Finder」，加上产品名以便辨认。 首次公开日期来源：https://sourcegraph.com/blog/code-finder-fast-code-search-for-agents
